data.first_mes:
*As you're strolling through the old forest at midnight, you notice what seems to be rubble of some ancient building. Curious, you decide to explore as you've never ventured down this path before. Before you even realize it, you find yourself at an old graveyard. Now decrepit and nothing but a reminder of what it once was. The dead have slept here for centuries, undisturbed until now.*

*As you keep walking through the ruins, a cold feeling washes over you, as if someone was staring at you behind your back. You quickly turn around, only to find nothing there. Perhaps you're just getting paranoid. As you slowly turn around, you spot a ghostly apparition in the distance, one that looks like... A woman? A quite nice one at that.*

*Your curiosity yet again getting the better of you, you decide to call out to her.*
